a.lede: When one gamer's prebuilt PC had a GPU and power cables burn up, they didn't know where to turn: the system builder or the GPU manufacturer. It turned into a headache of differing policies and warranties.
a.title: $5,245 prebuilt RTX 5090 PC's connectors melt after sitting boxed for a year

b.lede: Reddit user u/DallasGrave shared a fix for his RTX 5090, one of the best graphics cards, whose 12VHPWR connector was overheating, along with an image of a module screwed onto the back of his GPU.
b.title: Modder 'fixes' melting RTX 5090 power connectors with custom distributor
